[[Ritualist Deldrimor armor]] is the collective name used to refer to the stand alone armor pieces crafted for ritualists by [[Gobrech Stonefoot]] in [[Central Transfer Chamber]]. It is also sometimes referred to as Dwarven armor.

It is made up of the following pieces:
*[[Ritualist Opulent Raiment|Opulent Raiment]]
*[[Ritualist Scale Leggings|Scale Leggings]]
*[[Ritualist Beaded Shoes|Beaded Shoes]]

The total cost for all pieces would be 150{{Cloth}}, 100{{Scale}}, 50{{Hide}}, 15{{Deldrimor Steel}}, 10{{Fur}}, 5{{Leather}} and 30{{plat}}
